2.198.3
RadialScale.CustomLabels
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialScale.CustomLabels element specifies the custom labels for a RadialScale. This element
is optional. This element is of type CustomLabels.
The following is the parent element of the RadialScale.CustomLabels element.
Parent elements
RadialScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialScale.CustomLabels element.
 <xsd:element name="CustomLabels" type="CustomLabelsType" minOccurs="0" />
